goals.text: Every line Hermes adds under What changed carries one of the draft's references, or the draft stands.

outcomes.change: The cleaning script falls back to the draft when a stray line appears under What changed
outcomes.checked_by: tests that a rewrite with a paragraph before the first bullet, or an unindented line after a bullet, falls back to the draft with a warning naming the check; an indented continuation line is still joined and kept; a draft whose What changed holds a non-bullet line (such as "None.") passes when the rewrite keeps that line

problems.text: A line under What changed that is not a bullet or an indented continuation of one is never checked, so a rewrite can add an intro or an unreferenced claim and still be kept.
